output.reason: The release note [ev-25015016b295] and the PR [ev-a659463a22b9] only say that Kubernetes 1.32 is now the minimum supported version, and the compatibility row [ev-f88a947c0d4c] only lists ">= 1.32.0". To settle the consequence we need the check.go diff, or upstream text saying what happens on clusters older than 1.32.
